description: Read the credential records for one wallet: for each, the credential, the issuer, and whether it is pending (waiting for a person to check it), verified (a person read the issuer's public lookup, with the date and the page), not found, or run out. Only a verified record inside its dates opens a credentialed job. Free, keyless, no wallet needed, just the address; it shows no certificate number and no name. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

wallet.description: The 0x… address to read. Address only, never a private key.

name: credential_record_status
title: Where your credential record stands
